title: Chapter 199: If You Don’T Have Enough Strength, You Can Make Up For It With Equipment
content:
Chapter 199: If You Don’T Have Enough Strength, You Can Make Up For It With Equipment

Wu Qing sent a large number of Zerg dogs to monitor the city where the Spirit God Green Army was stationed.

Some one-star hosts, under the personal control of the Queen, wandered around to collect intelligence.

As soon as the Spirit God Green Army made a move, they were discovered by the Zerg.

The soldiers of this Spirit God Green Army were equipped with top-notch luxury equipment. In addition to the standard green full-body armor and melee weapons, they were also equipped with heavy armored ground dragon mounts!

The ground dragon, a powerful mount that was originally equipped by the strongest cavalry of the bear goblin clan, is now in their hands.

Their long-range attack weapons are no longer common javelins, but a well-made crossbow.

Although I have not seen this crossbow fired, from the information collected by the host, this crossbow is a powerful heavy crossbow with great power, and the predicted range and power are very terrible.

What Wu Qing cares about more is that the Zerg host has discovered several evil god priests with strength of at least four stars and above, and a large number of evil god priests. This powerful evil god priest team is the real core of this army and a super multiplier of the army's combat power!

The only thing that makes Wu Qing feel fortunate is that most of the soldiers in this army have not entered the star level, and such luxurious equipment is actually given to some ordinary soldiers.

It may be some restrictions that Wu Qing doesn't know about, so the bear goblin tribe can't send too many powerful troops, and can only improve the combat power of this army by strengthening equipment and mounts.

The quota of the strong should be given to the evil god priest.

"This bear goblin tribe has also taken great pains to deal with the Zerg!"

Wu Qing doesn't know what kind of equipment the normal spiritual god green department's direct army is equipped with, but the equipment of this green department's direct army really opened his eyes.

All members are equipped with heavy armored ground dragon mounts and heavy crossbows. They run fast, have strong long-range attack capabilities, and can carry a lot of weight. If the Zerg of the previous period relied on Zerg Zerglings and Hydralisks alone, they would definitely not be their opponents.

They are targeting the Zerg and are well prepared!

But the current Zerg will give them a big surprise!

…

The army directly under the Spirit God Green Department began to move out. They formed three support troops, each with about 50,000 soldiers directly under the Spirit God Green Department.

In each support force, there are several evil god priests led by the evil god high priests, responsible for commanding operations and faith blessing.

They rode on heavy armored ground dragons and carried heavy crossbows. Their ground dragon mounts were full of crossbows of various types.

The three support troops of the Spirit God Green Department's direct army went to three main directions to meet the armies of other bear goblins.

In order to test the actual combat power of these troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department, Wu Qing sent a team of 100 Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes to intercept a support force directly under the Spirit God Green Department.

When the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes flew over the sky of the troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department, the experienced evil god high priest sensed the danger. This unit should have experience in fighting against flying soldiers and soon discovered the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes in the air.

Some of the bear goblin soldiers riding on the back of the galloping heavy armored ground dragon have already held the heavy crossbows in their hands and strung them.

The power of these heavy crossbows can be seen from the strength of the bear goblin soldiers' stringing!

Some white light flew over from the evil god priest team, blessing the bear goblin soldiers and their weapons and equipment ready for battle. The heavy crossbows held by the bear goblin soldiers were covered by hazy white light.

This is a magical combination of technology and divine arts!

"Bang, bang, bang...!"

The dense crossbow arrows were covered with a faint light and shot straight at the Zerg Exploding Swarms that were swooping down from the sky!

The speed of the crossbow arrows was very fast, carrying an extremely sharp breath. When they were shot head-on, the Zerg Exploding Swarms immediately entered an accelerated state.

Even if the Zerg Exploding Swarms tried their best to dodge, more than half of them failed to pass through the dense crossbow arrows and were shot up in the air!

If it were just a few crossbow arrows, it might not be able to shoot up the Zerg Exploding Swarms. It was mainly because of the state of blessing of the evil god sacrifice that these crossbow arrows were attached with a strange energy, which greatly increased the power of the crossbow arrows!

"Boom, boom, boom...!"

The Zerg Exploding Swarms that successfully dived into the square formation of the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department exploded, and the violent explosion knocked down a group of soldiers and ground dragon mounts.

However, the powerful armor of the soldiers of the Lingshen Green Department and the powerful blessing of the evil god priests greatly reduced the killing effect of the Zerg explosive mosquitoes. The explosion of nearly 40 explosive mosquitoes actually killed few soldiers of the Lingshen Green Department.

The large amount of corrosive mucus produced by the Zerg explosive mosquitoes' self-explosion and air explosion splashed everywhere. The soldiers of the Lingshen Green Department, who were experienced in combat, picked up the shields hanging on the ground dragon mounts and blocked them in front of them.

They would use spare short weapons to clean up the corrosive mucus splashed on the places where the corrosive mucus was splashed.

Since they were all wearing full-body armor, and even the ground dragon mounts were wearing heavy armor, the corrosive damage caused by the explosion of the Zerg explosive mosquitoes was difficult to hurt their vitals.

After a careful cleaning, these soldiers of the Lingshen Green Department who were slightly injured rode their ground dragon mounts and continued to keep up with the main force.

Some non-fatal injuries, relying on their own recovery ability and the state of blessing of the evil god priests, would not affect their continued participation in the battle.

Originally, the hundreds of Zerg explosive mosquitoes that could easily destroy thousands of ordinary troops only caused a little trouble to the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department, and only a few enemies were actually killed.

Through this test, the Queen of Zerg calculated the range and power of the heavy crossbows equipped by the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department. The range of these heavy crossbows blessed by the evil god priests is comparable to that of the one-star hydralisk of the Zerg, and the lethality of the crossbows blessed by energy is not weaker than that of the one-star hydralisk.

These troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department rely solely on heavy crossbows and the blessing of the evil god priests, which is equivalent to the long-range combat power of 300,000 one-star hydralisks of the Zerg, not to mention their mounts, other equipment advantages and powerful evil god priests.

"300,000 one-star hydralisks?"

After Wu Qing got this result, he knew that it would be difficult for the Zerg flying dragon group to completely intercept the convergence of the bear goblin army today.

Twenty-five thousand Zerg dragons had to run away when facing the anti-air attack of fifty thousand one-star hydralisks. Wu Qing would not let the precious Zerg dragons fight the enemy head-on and consume them.

The Zerg dragon group has strong mobility. Before the direct army of the Spirit God Green Department comes to the door, they should fight as they should and seize the time to destroy the enemy's living forces.

When the Zerg dragon group quickly pursued and annihilated the enemy army and finally met the direct army of the Spirit God Green Department, they felt the power of the heavy crossbow and left without looking back.

The bear goblin tribe sent out three support troops. The two Zerg dragon groups did not fight the support troops head-on, but turned around and used their air and speed advantages to continue to pursue and annihilate other bear goblin troops.

In this way, within the sphere of influence of the bear goblin tribe, a good show of chasing, escaping, and being chased continued to be staged!

The 60,000 flying dragons of the Zerg, and a new batch of explosive mosquitoes, kept chasing and annihilating the army of the bear goblins that had not joined the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department.

Affected by the ordinary army of the bear goblins that were supported, the speed of the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department was restricted. The more ordinary army they supported, the greater this restriction was, making them increasingly unable to keep up with the rhythm of the Zerg flying dragon group.

There was a support force that wanted the ordinary army that was supported to return to the city where they were stationed first. This information was learned by the Zerg who had been monitoring them. After they left, the ordinary army they supported was attacked by a group of Zerg flying dragons.

When they returned to rescue, the large number of ordinary army of the bear goblins that had gathered together was already very few.

Faced with this situation, the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department sent two support forces of 50,000 people, almost draining the troops stationed in the city.

Five armies directly under the Spirit God Green Department, with a strength of nearly 250,000, fought wits and courage with the Zerg dragon group, and entangled until the afternoon, and successfully received more than one million ordinary troops of the Bugbear tribe.

The Zerg dragon group and explosive mosquitoes almost wiped out the other ordinary troops of the Bugbear tribe that gathered!

They also wiped out more than half of the logistics and material transport teams that were gathering more and more.

The two Zerg dragon groups, which were still not satisfied, were divided into five dragon groups again, and kept hovering around the five supporting troops that ran out for a distance. When they found an opportunity, they launched an attack on the ordinary troops of the Bugbear tribe that escaped death.

The heavy crossbows equipped by the troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department also have a limited range. It is inevitable that there will be places that they cannot take care of when they have to guard the ordinary troops that are several times more than their own with 50,000 troops.

The Zerg dragon group kept harassing them outside, and when they saw the opportunity, they would output a lot and continue to eliminate the ordinary troops of the Bugbear tribe.

When the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department counterattacks, the Zerg flying dragon group will fly away quickly and turn to attack the logistics transport team of the bear goblin tribe. Without an organized army to fight, these logistics teams composed of the evil god's fanatics are also good targets for attack.

After repeating this several times, the nearly one million surviving troops of the bear goblin tribe finally successfully arrived at the city where the army directly under the Spirit God Green Department was stationed.

This city cannot accommodate so many troops, and the temporary logistics supplies have not been transported. Most of these surviving one million troops can only be stationed outside the city in the open air.

The 300,000 troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department are also restless. In order to guard against the sudden attack of the Zerg flying dragon group, they deployed a large number of troops around to form a tight air defense network and wait for it.

They no longer have the spare energy to meet the logistics material transportation team. The various logistics material transportation teams that are rushing over can only leave it to fate, hoping that the lucky team can pass through the interception of the Zerg flying dragon group and arrive successfully.

The logistics and material transport teams were slow to move and were huge targets, so it was almost impossible to evade the Zerg's reconnaissance.

Seeing that the Spirit God Green Department's direct army had defended the city tightly, the Zerg dragons could only go looking for trouble with the logistics and material transport teams and wipe them out one by one.
